points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake exposes CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and finds MPI/CGNS/HDF5/METIS; README gives build/run commands. A clean evaluator build was not performed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements solve --case --output and rejects malformed invocation paths; no independent negative-path run was performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, halo, flux, reconstruction, residual, integration, and output are separated into named modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal call to an existing solver executable is evident. Trust policy precludes external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON controls physics/run settings; source does not branch only on the two benchmark mesh names.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Neighbor Isend/Irecv halo packing and global reductions are implemented, but only np=4 failed outputs are present and no rank-consistency comparison is delivered.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Source has mesh/positivity guards and owned/ghost layout, but no clean-build, stress, or malformed-input evidence was delivered.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No tests directory, CI, or submitted validator pass. The three available results are failed and five required packages are absent.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ and documentation; remaining TODO for temperature gradient and generated/build debris outside the curated submission limit polish.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
